remarks: Set on 1.79 gated acres in the heart of mid-country Greenwich, this extraordinary property offers a rare combination of complete privacy, refined elegance, and modern luxury living. Tucked far back from a quiet country road and within a neighborhood of $10+ million estates, this property unfolds like a private botanical retreat--featuring sweeping perennial gardens, flowering shrubs, magnificent specimen plantings, and expansive open lawns that create year-round beauty and serenity. Completely rebuilt in 2019, the sophisticated Colonial residence spans 5,417 square feet with 4 bedrooms and 5 baths, masterfully designed for both grand entertaining and comfortable everyday living.
